roundTrip.method: Blender 5.1 headless: import_scene.gltf -> export_anim.bvh (global_scale=1), mirroring retarget_bvh load.py saveGltf2Bvh:382
roundTrip.note: All 66 joint names survive glTF->BVH verbatim (ball_l ... upperarm_r). The importer STACKS all 87 clips into one action (active action after import was 'Chest_Open'), so a raw-library load_and_retarget would bind the wrong motion; the bind consumes an extracted single-clip GLB instead.

control.note: The shipped stage report counts 22 real-driven bones (keyframes>1 && totalRotationDeltaRad>0.01). The planted contract's control constant is 26 - the count of channels the CMU bind produced before that filter. Clause (1) must beat 26.

mapConsumptionMechanism.summary: retarget_bvh consumes a SOURCE map by RENAMING imported source bones to MHX canonical names (load.py renameBones:679 via BD.activeSrcInfo.boneNames keyed on utils.py canonicalName:234 lower/underscore); the TARGET map tags MPFB bones with the same MHX names for the actual transfer. Map keys are exact source joint names; values are MHX names shared with mpfb2-default-no-toes.json.
mapConsumptionMechanism.autoSourceDefault: useAutoSource=True falls back to armature.py findArmature geometry heuristics when no map matches; our map matches by name so renameBones uses it directly
